data.content_ref: inline:Keep the fixpoint untouched but attach a blocking frontier to every suspended node: instead of a single UNDEC label, carry the set of attackers that are themselves UNDEC and jointly block the node; the frontier is computed in the same pass at no asymptotic cost, is deterministic, and gives adjudicators a targeted, citable reason for suspension without changing acceptance. The critique is that this enriches observability, not the extension's decisiveness.
